objective: Optimize C# PDF/Word/TXT conversion into complete Markdown directory bundles informed by the supplied OpenViking analysis.
behavior: Shared deterministic bundle writer produces sections and ordered per-directory indexes, relative media links and manifests; generic conversion returns bundle metadata.
Knowledge atomically publishes the same bundle format; indexes are readonly owned projections with controlled URI rewriting and a parsed_index UI entry.
Layout version 2 reads previous version 1; sections retain exact source interval coverage; index files excluded from body counts and coverage.
PDF samples up to 32 pages for body font, deduplicates rendered PNGs across pages and keeps existing table/image/vector/scan behavior.

Word preserves inline styles, safe links, numbering hierarchy, content-control tables, notes and embedded assets; TXT uses strict Unicode/BOM and guarded GB18030/GBK fallback with unchanged source bytes.
Fenced blocks and inline Markdown links/images remain atomic across splits; bounded section count and reserved index filenames.
Chat and project text-only consumers explicitly avoid unused intermediate bundles and keep prior storage behavior.
